1018.description: A shrug with a band, lifting the shoulders toward the ears. It trains the traps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet, holding the ends with your hands.
Keep your arms straight and relaxed, and let the band hang in front of your thighs.
Engage your traps by shrugging your shoulders upward, lifting the band as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将弹力带放在脚下，用手握住两端。
保持手臂伸直并放松，让弹力带悬挂在大腿前面。
向上耸肩，尽可能高地举起弹力带，以启动斜方肌。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将肩膀放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1082.description: From a plank with feet in straps, you pull the knees toward the chest. It trains the abs and core control.
instructions: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull your knees toward your chest by rolling your hips up.
Pause briefly.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.

1146.description: A push-up with the feet spread in the straps, which adds a big core and hip challenge.
instructions: Place your feet in the straps spread wide in a high plank.
Keep your core tight.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up.
Hold the wide leg position the whole set.

1210.description: A standing cable row at a high angle with a torso twist. It hits the upper back and rear shoulders.
instructions: Set a cable at about head height and stand facing it with the handle in one hand.
Take a split stance and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle toward your upper chest, turning your torso as you go.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Complete the set and switch sides.

1274.description: A deep push-up with a longer range of motion. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从高平板支撑位置开始，双手分开略宽于肩宽，身体呈一条直线。
弯曲肘部，使胸部靠近地面，使胸部靠近地面。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1338.description: Sit on a stability ball and lean back into it while hugging the ball. It gently opens up the back and stretches the spine.
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold the stability ball with both hands, hugging it close to your chest.
Engage your core muscles and slowly lean back, keeping your back straight and your feet planted on the ground.
Continue leaning back until you feel a stretch in your back muscles.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，背部挺直。
用双手握住稳定球，将其抱在靠近胸部的位置。
启动你的核心肌肉，慢慢向后倾斜，保持背部挺直，双脚踩在地上。
继续向后倾斜，直到感觉到背部肌肉伸展。
保持该姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1402.description: An isometric hold where your body is supported by your arms and your legs stay straight out in front, forming an L.
instructions: Sit between two supports or on the floor and place your hands beside your hips.
Press down through your hands to lift your hips and legs off the floor.
Extend your legs straight in front of you.
Keep your shoulders pressed down and your core tight.
Hold for as long as you can with good form, then lower.

1466.description: Lying on your back, you lift your hips and add a gentle twist. It wakes up the glutes and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands by your sides for support.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
While keeping your hips lifted, twist your lower body to the right side, bringing your knees towards the ground.
Return to the starting position and repeat the twist to the left side.
Continue alternating twists for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 仰卧，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在身体两侧以获得支撑。
收紧臀部并将臀部抬离地面，从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在保持臀部抬起的同时，将下半身扭转到右侧，使膝盖靠近地面。
返回起始位置并向左侧重复扭转。
继续交替扭转所需的重复次数。

1530.description: A snatch caught overhead above parallel. It builds explosive power and speed.
instructions: Hold the bar at your shins with a wide grip, flat back and chest up.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull under and catch the bar overhead with locked arms in a quarter squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

1594.description: A front-loaded squat on the smith machine with your arms stretched straight in front. It strongly challenges the quads and upper back posture.
instructions: Set the bar at upper chest height and rest it on your front shoulders.
Extend your arms straight forward, like a zombie, to keep the bar in place.
Unrack the bar and step into a stable stance.
Squat down with your chest up and your torso upright.
Drive through your heels to stand and rerack when finished.

1658.description: A lunge paired with a bicep curl. It trains the biceps, quads and glutes together.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position. Your right knee should be bent at a 90-degree angle and your left knee should be hovering just above the ground.
As you lunge forward, simultaneously curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the lunge, then push through your right heel to return to the starting position, lowering the dumbbells back down to your sides.
Repeat the lunge and bicep curl on the opposite side, stepping forward with your left foot.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
右脚向前迈出一步，将身体降低至弓步位置。你的右膝应该弯曲成 90 度角，左膝应该悬停在地面上方。
当你向前弓步时，同时将哑铃向肩膀弯曲，保持肘部靠近身体。
在弓步底部停顿片刻，然后通过右脚跟推动回到起始位置，将哑铃放回身体两侧。
在另一侧重复弓步和二头肌弯举，左脚向前迈出。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1722.description: A triceps extension at a high pulley, with the cable overhead. It targets the long head of the triceps.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing away from the machine.
Grasp the rope with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Keep your elbows close to your head and your upper arms stationary.
Slowly lower the rope behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳子连接到高滑轮上，背对机器站立。
双手抓住绳子，并将双臂伸过头顶。
保持肘部靠近头部，上臂保持静止。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将绳子降低到头后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1786.description: With a partner helping you lean the trunk forward, you stretch your chest and front shoulders. It gives a controlled, deeper opening.
instructions: Sit or stand with your hands clasped behind your head and your elbows wide.
Have your partner pull your elbows back as you gently tilt your trunk forward.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1850.description: A simple forearm stretch for the wrist flexors, helpful after gripping or typing.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with the palm up.
Use your other hand to pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep your elbow straight and your shoulder relaxed.
Feel the stretch along the inner forearm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

1914.description: Seated wide leg stretch that opens the inner thighs while lengthening the hamstrings.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide and knees straight.
Sit tall with your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from the hips, walking your hands out in front of you.
Stop when you feel a stretch along the inner thighs and backs of the legs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly, then sit back up.

1978.description: A stretch for the back of the shoulder and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand tall and extend one arm behind you.
Reach across to grab it with the other hand.
Draw the arm gently back and across the body.
Keep your chest open and your shoulders down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2106.description: Rounds the spine upward from all fours to loosen the back and gently engage the abs. A classic mobility move for stiff backs.
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Tuck your chin and tilt the pelvis as you push the floor away.
Round your back up toward the ceiling like a cat.
Hold the rounded position for a few seconds.
Return slowly to the neutral starting position.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps.

2234.description: Raising dumbbells out to your sides to build the middle part of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your core.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and avoid shrugging.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to the start and repeat.

2298.description: A bodyweight row hanging beneath a bench or bar, pulling your chest up. Trains the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Set up a bench at a height that allows your body to hang freely underneath it.
Lie face up on the ground with your head towards the bench.
Reach up and grab the bench with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Position your body so that your heels are on the ground and your arms are fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull your chest up towards the bench.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一张长凳，其高度应让您的身体可以自由地悬挂在其下方。
面朝上躺在地上，头朝向长凳。
向上伸手，正手握住长凳，握距略宽于肩宽。
调整身体位置，使脚后跟着地，手臂完全伸展。
当你将胸部拉向长凳时，启动你的核心并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低身体回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2362.description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back, brace your core and squat down.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays flat and braced without rounding at the bottom.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2746.description: A machine squat that adds an outward leg push to work the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Set the machine and step in with the pads on your shoulders.
Squat down with control, keeping your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Push your knees slightly outward as you rise.
Keep your core braced.

2810.description: A barbell split squat with a long stance. Builds the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Take a large step forward with your right foot, keeping your torso upright.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg forward for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽站立，将杠铃放在上背部。
右脚向前迈出一大步，保持躯干直立。
弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
左腿向前重复此动作，达到所需的重复次数。

2874.description: A Pilates plank variation with a leg lift that builds core and shoulder stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels.
Lift one leg a few inches without shifting your hips.
Lower it and repeat on the other leg.
Keep your abs tight and your neck long.

2938.description: A dead bug with a band resisting your arms. It adds shoulder and trunk demand to a classic core drill.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a band overhead and bring your knees up at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping band tension.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Keep your ribs down and move slowly.

3002.description: A one-arm push-up from the knees, a stepping stone toward the full single-arm version. It builds chest and trunk strength.
instructions: Kneel and place one hand under your shoulder, with the other arm behind your back.
Spread your knees a bit wider for balance.
Keep a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Press back up without twisting your hips.
Switch arms and repeat.

3130.description: A drill where you shrug your shoulders up and then press them down. It builds control of the shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with your arms at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Hold for a second.
Press your shoulders down away from your ears.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your arms relaxed and your head still.

3194.description: A front-loaded barbell squat held out in front of the body with straight arms. It hits the glutes and quads and demands a tall, braced torso.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell in front of your body with straight arms.
Keeping your back straight, lower your body by bending at the knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双臂伸直将杠铃举在身体前方。
保持背部挺直，弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
暂停片刻，然后用力推动脚后跟，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3258.description: Big arm circles with both arms to warm up the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend both arms out to the sides.
Make slow circles forward.
Then reverse direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

3322.description: A beginner friendly deadlift with a kettlebell between your feet. It teaches the hip hinge and builds glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Stand with feet hip width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grab the handle with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet and stand tall, squeezing your glutes.
Hinge back down to set the kettlebell on the floor and repeat.

3386.description: A machine isolation move for the front of the thighs.
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Hook your lower shins under the roller and align your knees with the pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Avoid swinging or lifting your hips.

3514.description: A one-leg bridge curl with the heel on a towel. It's a tougher hamstring and glute exercise.
instructions: Lie on your back with one heel on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift the other leg straight up.
Raise your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heel away until the leg is nearly straight.
Pull the heel back toward your glutes.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

3578.description: Pass a kettlebell around your waist in a circle to build core control and coordination.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hold the kettlebell in one hand.
Pass it behind your back to the other hand.
Bring it around your waist to the front.
Keep your hips square and core tight.
Repeat in the same direction, then reverse.

3642.description: A weighted lunge into a deep stretch for the hips. It trains the glutes and quads while opening up the hip flexors.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your back straight.
Lower your body by bending your knees until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持背部挺直。
弯曲膝盖降低身体，直到右大腿与地面平行。
推动右脚跟回到起始位置。
左腿重复上述动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。

3706.description: A squat that explodes into a tuck jump. It trains explosive leg power and fast landings.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat with your arms back.
Explode upward and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly with bent knees.
Sink straight into the next squat and repeat.

3770.description: A squat combined with a one-arm band row. It trains your legs and your back together.
instructions: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and the band under light tension.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat while keeping your chest up.
Stand up and, at the top, pull the handle to your ribs with your elbow close to your body, then let it return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

3834.description: A hang from a hangboard in a half crimp grip. It builds finger strength for climbing.
instructions: Place your fingers on the edge with the knuckles bent at about 90 degrees.
Step off and hang with straight arms.
Keep your shoulders engaged.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Rest fully between hangs.

3962.description: Small alternating leg kicks while seated and leaning back. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit with your hands behind you and lean back slightly.
Lift both legs off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in short alternating moves.
Keep your core tight and your back from rounding.
Continue for time.

4026.description: A band warm-up with the arms moving in front of the body, loosening the shoulders and chest before a workout.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold the band in front of you at shoulder height.
Keep your arms mostly straight.
Move your hands apart, stretching the band across your chest.
Bring your hands back together slowly.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps.

4090.description: A wide stance squat holding the end of a landmine barbell at your chest, which trains glutes and legs with an upright torso.
instructions: Stand facing the landmine anchor with a wide stance and hold the bar end against your chest.
Brace your core and keep your elbows tucked in.
Sit down between your legs, knees tracking over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your heels to stand tall.

4154.description: A seated wrist curl with palms facing each other. It strengthens the forearms and wrists.
instructions: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, hand hanging past the knee.
Hold the weight with a neutral grip, thumb up.
Curl your wrist up toward your forearm.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly until your wrist is extended.
Complete all reps, then switch arms.

4218.description: A squat with a safety squat bar held in front using its handles. It loads the quads and keeps your torso upright.
instructions: Set the safety bar on a rack and step under the pad.
Hold the handles, rest the pad on your shoulders and unrack.
Step back and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while keeping your chest tall and elbows up.
Go as deep as you can with good form.
Drive up through your whole foot to stand.

4282.description: A gentle stretch for the feet and ankles. It helps loosen stiff joints and the muscles around them.
instructions: Sit on a chair or the floor with one leg extended.
Point your toes away from you.
Hold for 15 seconds.
Pull your toes back toward your shin.
Hold for another 15 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

4346.description: A standing overhead press without weight, good for learning the pressing path or warming up.
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and fists at your shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press your arms straight overhead.
Lower back to your shoulders with control.
Avoid leaning back.

4410.description: A strong standing pose with wide legs and arms outstretched, building leg strength, hip opening and stamina.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Gaze over your front fingertips and keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

4474.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the deep glutes (piriformis). A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your deep glutes (piriformis) while lying on your back with your knee falling across your body.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4538.description: A floor pullover with a kettlebell and bent knees. It stretches and works the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest with elbows slightly bent.
Lower it back over your head, feeling a stretch in your lats.
Keep your lower back close to the floor.
Pull it back over your chest and repeat.

4602.description: Using a light pipe to practice rotating the shoulders outward, building control and range for overhead lifts.
instructions: Hold a PVC pipe in both hands with your elbows tucked at your sides and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows pinned and rotate the pipe so one hand moves outward.
Return to the start and rotate the other way.
Move slowly and keep your ribs down and your wrists straight.
Continue alternating for the planned reps.

4730.description: A one-arm row from a hinged position, pulling a dumbbell toward your hip. It trains the lats and mid back.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and hinge forward with a flat back, knees slightly bent.
Let the weight hang with your arm straight below your shoulder.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

4794.description: An explosive one-leg glute bridge where you pop your hips off the floor. It builds glute power and balance.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot planted and the other leg lifted.
Drive through the planted heel and thrust your hips up.
Push hard enough that your hips leave the floor.
Land softly back in the bridge.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

4858.description: A push-up combined with side steps. It trains the chest and shoulders with extra coordination.
instructions: Start in a high plank.
Do one push-up.
Step your hands and feet to the side.
Do another push-up.
Alternate direction after a set.

4922.description: A fly in the rings from a push up position. It stretches and works the chest with a lot of core control.
instructions: Set the rings low and hold them in a plank position.
Keep your arms nearly straight with a small bend in the elbows.
Open your arms out to the sides, lowering your chest.
Pull the rings back together with your chest.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Go only as wide as you can control.

4986.description: Step up onto a bench or box holding dumbbells. It trains your legs and glutes one side at a time.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a sturdy bench.
Place one foot fully on the bench.
Drive through that heel to stand up tall on the bench.
Lower your trailing foot back down under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

5050.description: Lying on your back with legs raised, you reach up to touch your toes alternately. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs raised toward the ceiling.
Extend your arms up.
Crunch up and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Lower and reach with the other hand.
Keep your legs steady.

5178.description: A plate-loaded machine extension done one leg at a time. It isolates the quads and evens out left-right differences.
instructions: Sit in the machine and adjust the pad to rest on your lower shin.
Place one foot under the pad and keep the other planted.
Extend your knee until your leg is almost straight.
Pause briefly and squeeze your quads.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

5242.description: Pulling your belly in while kneeling. It teaches deep abdominal control.
instructions: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Relax your belly toward the floor.
Draw your navel up toward your spine.
Hold for 10-15 seconds while breathing normally.
Release slowly and repeat.

5370.description: A one-arm hammer curl on a cable using a rope. Hits the biceps and forearm muscles with a neutral grip.
instructions: Attach the rope to a low pulley and hold it with one hand, thumb up.
Stand tall with your elbow tucked in.
Curl the rope toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the top for a second.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

5498.description: Marching in place while holding a plate overhead, building leg strength, balance and shoulder stability.
instructions: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Stand tall with ribs down and core braced.
Lift one knee toward hip height.
Lower it and lift the other knee in a controlled march.
Keep the plate steady and avoid leaning back.

5754.description: A hip thrust with a dumbbell resting on your hips. Strong glute builder for the glutes.
instructions: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant your feet flat, shoulder-width apart.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top with your chin tucked.
Lower under control and repeat.

5818.description: Raise light weights in front at a diagonal with thumbs up. It trains the shoulder muscles that lift the arm.
instructions: Hold a light weight in each hand with thumbs pointing up.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Raise your arms diagonally forward to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly with control.

5882.description: A squat with a diagonal chopping arm motion that trains the legs and teaches the trunk to rotate with control.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped above one shoulder.
Squat down while chopping your hands diagonally toward the opposite knee.
Rotate through your trunk and let your back foot pivot.
Stand up as you swing your arms back up.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

6010.description: Fast alternating knee drives with arms pumping overhead, a fun cardio drill.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up as you raise your arms in a victory pose.
Lower and switch.
Keep a quick, bouncy rhythm.
Land lightly and work for 30 seconds.

6074.description: A side raise with bottles that builds the shoulder caps.
instructions: Stand tall with a bottle in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.

6138.description: A deep squatting pose with the palms pressed together in front of the chest. It opens the hips and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than your hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat.
Press your palms together at the chest.
Use your elbows to gently press your knees outward.
Keep your chest lifted and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Stand up slowly.

6266.description: A seated cable curl with an SZ bar, with the cable set up overhead. It targets the biceps.
instructions: Sit facing the cable machine.
Grip the SZ bar and extend your arms.
Curl the bar toward your head.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly.
Keep your elbows high.

7418.description: A glute bridge with one foot placed forward to shift more load to one side.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, one foot forward of the other.
Press through both heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your hips level.
Lower slowly.
Switch the foot position halfway through.

7994.description: A dumbbell chest press done lying in a glute bridge. It works the chest and triceps while the glutes hold your hips up.
instructions: Lie on your back holding dumbbells at chest level, knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower with control while holding your hips high.
Finish your reps, then lower your hips.

8634.description: A seated drill of circular arm rolls and trunk rotation that lifts your heart rate.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists in a boxing guard.
Roll your arms in circles while rotating your trunk side to side.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.

10042.description: A floor press with the dumbbells pressed together. The squeeze keeps your chest working throughout the lift.
instructions: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand, pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze the dumbbells against each other.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Press back up while still squeezing.
Keep your wrists straight and elbows tucked.
Lower slowly each rep.

10106.description: An explosive pull taking the bar from the thighs to chest height. It builds power in the traps, hips and legs.
instructions: Hold a barbell at mid-thigh with an overhand grip, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug hard.
Pull the bar up to chest height, elbows high.
Let the bar settle and lower it to the thighs.
Reset your stance.
Keep the bar close to your body.

10554.description: From a plank, tap a ball with alternating hands. It challenges your core to stay stable.
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with a ball in front of you.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Lift one hand and tap the ball.
Return the hand and tap with the other.
Keep your hips as still as possible.

10746.description: A seated knee extension against band tension. It isolates the quads one leg at a time.
instructions: Sit on a bench and secure a band around one ankle.
Anchor the other end behind you.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Squeeze the front of your thigh at the top.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs.

11258.description: A standing move with one arm pressing while the other rows. It trains pushing and pulling together and tests your core.
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance between two cables, one handle in each hand.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Press one handle forward while pulling the other back toward your ribs.
Reverse the roles slowly.
Alternate sides for the set.

11450.description: A simple stair step-up done on the first and second steps. It builds leg strength and balance using everyday stairs.
instructions: Stand facing the stairs with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot on the first step and push through the heel to climb up.
Continue onto the second step, then step back down in control.
Keep your torso tall and your knee tracking over your toes.
Alternate the leading leg each rep or finish all reps on one side first.

0058.description: A hip thrust style lift with the bar resting on your hips. Strong work for the glutes.
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip and position it on your hips.
Engaging your glutes, lift your hips off the bench until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 仰卧在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，膝盖弯曲。
正手握住杠铃并将其放在臀部上。
收紧臀部，将臀部抬离长凳，直到身体从膝盖到肩膀形成一条直线。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将臀部放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0122.description: A bench press with a wide grip. Emphasises the chest.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Lower the barbell slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows slightly flared out.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest, then push it back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
宽握距抓住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
将杠铃从架子上提起，并将其直接放在胸部上方，双臂完全伸展。
慢慢地将杠铃向胸部降低，保持肘部稍微张开。
当杠铃接触胸部时暂停片刻，然后将其推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0186.description: Lying cable triceps extension with a rope. You lower the rope toward the forehead and extend again, isolating the triceps.
instructions: Attach a rope handle to a low pulley cable machine.
Lie down on a flat bench facing up, with your head towards the cable machine.
Grasp the rope handle with both hands, palms facing each other, and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the rope handle towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳索手柄连接到低滑轮电缆机器上。
面朝上躺在平坦的长凳上，头朝向电缆机。
双手抓住绳柄，掌心相对，将双臂伸直至胸前。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将绳索手柄放低至前额。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将手臂伸回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0250.description: A gentle neck stretch where you tilt the head back to look at the ceiling. It opens the front of the neck.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with relaxed shoulders.
Slowly tilt your head back to look at the ceiling.
Open your mouth slightly to relax the jaw.
Feel the stretch along the front of your neck.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return to neutral slowly.

0314.description: An incline dumbbell bench press. The raised bench shifts the work toward the upper chest.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed firmly against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward, and lift them to shoulder height.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，背部紧贴长凳。
双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向前，将哑铃举至肩高。
慢慢地将哑铃降低到胸部两侧，保持肘部呈 90 度角。
将哑铃推回起始位置，充分伸展手臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0378.description: Bent forward, you swing dumbbells out to the sides with a soft elbow bend. It builds the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arms straight down towards the ground, palms facing each other.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lift your arms out to the sides and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，每只手各握一个哑铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将双臂笔直向下伸向地面，手掌相对。
保持肘部轻微弯曲，将手臂向两侧抬起，并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手臂放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0570.description: Seated on a flat bench, you pull your knees in toward your chest and extend them again. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your legs extended straight out in front of you.
Place your hands on the bench beside your hips for support.
Engage your abs and lift your legs off the ground, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的长凳上，双腿在身前伸直。
将双手放在臀部旁边的长凳上以获得支撑。
收紧腹肌，将双腿抬离地面，使膝盖靠近胸部。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0634.description: A slow lowering crunch where you control the way down. Works the abs with extra time under tension.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地上。
将双手放在脑后，肘部朝外。
收紧腹肌，慢慢将上半身抬离地面，向前卷曲，直到躯干呈 45 度角。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将上半身放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0698.description: An overhead press using a band for resistance. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band at shoulder height.
Press your hands overhead until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight.
Lower slowly back to the shoulders.
Avoid leaning back.

0762.description: A wide-grip row that pulls toward the upper chest to hit the back of the shoulders. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged as you pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度，将自己放在机器上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地面上。
正手握住手柄，握距略宽于肩宽。
将手柄拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0826.description: A leg raise done hanging or supported between parallel bars, lifting straight legs in front. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Hang from the parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or slightly higher.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在双杠上，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或稍高。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0954.description: Kneel and sit between your feet, stretching the thighs and ankles. A grounded seat for breathing or meditation.
instructions: Kneel with knees together and feet slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips down between your heels, using a block if needed.
Rest your hands on your thighs and lengthen your spine.
Relax your shoulders and breathe evenly.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, then come out slowly.
